_comment: SUPERSEDED — this registry format belongs to the withdrawn per-OS-account design.
It is NOT how tenants are provisioned any more. See credentials/README.md and
docs/design/MULTI_TENANCY_PR_PLAN.md section 1 for why that design was withdrawn.
To add a tenant, use:  python3 tools/provision_tenant.py --user <id> --account <acct>
which writes to the encrypted credential store (common/credstore.py) that
dashboard/auth.py actually reads from.
Retained only as a reference for the '_legacy' single-user tenant, which still
resolves through common.tenancy.load_registry(). Do not copy this for a new tenant.
--- original notes below ---
Example tenant registry. Copy to tenants.json (gitignored) and edit.
See docs/design/MULTI_TENANCY.md §5.
INVARIANTS enforced at load time by common.tenancy.load_registry():
- user_id: lowercase alnum plus '_' and '-', 2-32 chars, must start alnum.
- account_number: EXACTLY ONE tenant per brokerage account. Two tenants sharing
an account number is a hard config error, because it would make the ownership
guard meaningless.
- broker_server: the MCP server name bound to THAT user's Robinhood OAuth token.
Note that all Robinhood MCP servers currently share one URL, so the server name
plus its bound token is the only thing distinguishing accounts. This file does
not create that binding; it records it so code can refuse mismatches.
OWNERSHIP: this file should be owned by an administrative account and NOT writable
by any tenant. A tenant able to edit it can reassign its own account number.
